title: DW3 port cards/c<nnn>/card.json as exported (cards-card-v1, descriptive)
description: The card.json the game exports for an ORIGINAL card (data/cards/c<nnn>/card.json beside face.png), from pc/shim/card_export.c (onFace). Descriptive: never read. The same format name is the registry record of a mod's NEW card (cards/<key>/card.json), which is a different set of members: see card.schema.json for that one.

name.description: The folder, c<number> with three digits.

number.description: The game's card number (card file * 64 + index + 1).

file.description: The disc file in lowercase without AAA/ (dat/card/cardpak0.bin).

index.description: The card's index inside that file.
